description: This file defines an interface for collateral-related write operations in the Fineract platform, including methods to add, update, and delete collateral information associated with loans.

classes.name: CollateralWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface declaring collateral modification methods such as addCollateral, updateCollateral, and deleteCollateral.

methods.name: addCollateral
methods.description: Creates and adds new collateral for a specified loan.

methods.name: updateCollateral
methods.description: Updates existing collateral information for a specified loan.

methods.name: deleteCollateral
methods.description: Deletes existing collateral from a specified loan.
